accessibilityTree:
- main:
  - region "Enroll the first administrator":
    - paragraph: Campus Commander
    - heading "Enroll the first administrator" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Choose the browser profile for your administrator account before entering the private administrator pairing code from the installer terminal.
    - paragraph: The code works once. Keep this browser open until enrollment completes.
    - text: Installer pairing code
    - textbox "Installer pairing code"
    - button "Sign in to enroll administrator" [disabled]
    - alert: This pairing code has already started sign-in in a browser.
    - region "Restart administrator enrollment":
      - paragraph: "Obtain a new pairing code to continue in this browser:"
      - list:
        - listitem: In the installer terminal, press Ctrl+C.
        - listitem: Run the same installer command again and select Resume.
        - listitem: Enter its new administrator pairing code in this browser.
      - paragraph: Your Google client configuration and application data remain in place.
    - link "Return to sign-in":
      - /url: /login
